attributes.name: pill-shaped button usage
attributes.definition: Whether pill-shaped (fully rounded) buttons are used on the page, and for what purpose.

values.definition: Pill-shaped buttons used to filter or categorize content lists.
A pill-shaped button used to submit a search field.
Pill-shaped buttons used for other actions such as CTAs.

attributes.name: search field submit control
attributes.definition: How the primary search input is paired with a submit control.

values.definition: Search field is accompanied by a visible button with a text label such as Search.
Search field has an icon-only submit button.
Search field has no visible submit control, relying on Enter or live filtering.

attributes.name: content filtering mechanism
attributes.definition: How users narrow down lists of items on the page.

values.definition: A row of buttons or chips for selecting a category to filter.
Filtering via dropdown or select menus.
Filtering by typing into a search input.
